summary: Brightstar Lottery PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing open-market repurchases of 303,500 ordinary shares under its existing $500M buyback program. Shares were bought in two tranches on June 18 and June 26, 2026, at prices between $11.13 and $12.00 per share, for an aggregate $3.5M. Repurchased shares are held in treasury. No board recommendation, advisors, or structural complexities noted. This is a routine capital-return activity under a previously disclosed program; watch for future buyback pace and potential program exhaustion.
